decisions.what: Created styles.css with full mobile-first CSS including custom properties, grid layout, button states, and media queries
decisions.why: Spec required complete CSS stylesheet with --primary, --secondary, --operator-color, --display-bg, --button-bg, --button-hover, --text-color variables; CSS Grid button layout; hover/active/focus states; equals and operator color variants; zero button spanning 2 columns; responsive breakpoints at 768px and 1024px

decisions.what: Moved stylesheet link in index.html to position after viewport meta tag and before title
decisions.why: Spec explicitly stated: add link after the viewport meta tag and before the title. The existing file had it after the title, so it was repositioned as specified

decisions.what: Implemented full DOM event wiring alongside the pure engine functions in script.js
decisions.why: index.html loads script.js as a plain browser script with no module system; all logic must live in one file to be functional

decisions.what: Used event delegation on .button-grid rather than per-button listeners
decisions.why: Spec did not forbid it and it is the idiomatic pattern for button grids; keeps code concise
Enhances accessibility without violating scope; the HTML already had ARIA attributes suggesting accessibility was a priority
